context.title: Track AIPAC — November 3, 2026 California general election endorsements and ratings (California picks only)

labels.label: Endorsed
labels.description: We support candidates who: Reject support from AIPAC & their allies; Call for an immediate & permanent ceasefire; Support a total arms embargo & conditioning all aid to Israel; Support Palestinian rights & statehood; Oppose lobbying by unregistered foreign agents; Support overturning Citizens United

labels.label: Pro-Israel
labels.description: Red graphics are assigned when we evaluate a candidate’s policy as pro-Israel based on their voting record (if one exists), any published policy positions, any public statements, and any credible reporting verifying that the candidate is seeking AIPAC’s support
